Theta GmbH’s strategy of filing for multiple patents on next-generation wireless communication is a high-impact move designed to establish a temporary monopoly. This will likely create significant barriers to entry, forcing our team to either invest heavily in alternative technological solutions or navigate complex licensing negotiations. This could delay our product roadmap and increase R&D costs, necessitating a swift pivot to ensure we maintain competitive parity without infringing on their intellectual property.
